comment: Estimates in seconds, used only to balance the shards and to order them (longest first). They are guesses until a run has measured them: copy the 'Slowest packages' tables of the shard summaries here. internal/lint is 1500 because one full local run of the package took 1494 s, and internal/store/catalogtest is 1200 because a run on a busy machine took 1589 s. The mutant numbers are seconds as if the mutants ran one at a time; with -j 2 the wall time of a shard is shorter than its estimate, so the shard timeouts, which are set from the estimate, are generous on purpose. A wrong value unbalances the shards and breaks nothing.
